items.title: Data & Strategy Operations Specialist
items.description: Hey there, Future Data & Strategy Operations Specialist @ Better Collective! 👋 Our mission is to be the world’s leading digital sports media company, making sports entertainment more engaging and transparent for fans worldwide. Better Collective is the team behind industry-leading sports and betting media brands such as Action Network, HLTV, RotoGrinders, The Nation Network, BolaVIP, and Playmaker , reaching 400M+ monthly visits across digital, social, mobile, and CTV platforms. With FanReach at the core of our audience strategy, we’re transforming first-party data into a powerful monetization engine for advertisers. We connect high-intent sports fans with performance-focused brands through advanced data, contextual targeting, and scalable audience solutions. We’re now looking for a Data & Strategy Operations Specialist to help stand up, implement, and operationalize our Data Management Platform (DMP) and contextual targeting solutions from the ground up. This is a high-impact individual contributor role , ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building systems from scratch, and knows how to turn complex data into commercial outcomes. You’ll report directly to Alex Payne and work closely with Commercial, Product, Tech, and Data partners across regions. This role is for you if… You’re a builder at heart. You’ve helped implement or operate a DMP, CDP, or audience data solution before, and you’re excited by the challenge of taking something from zero to one. You’re equally comfortable going deep into technical details and stepping back to think strategically about monetization, scale, and market impact. You can work independently, but you know when and how to collaborate to move things forward. Sports experience is a plus, curiosity, ownership, and execution mindset are essential. How You’ll Make an Impact Here are some of the ways you’ll contribute to our mission: Own the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and optimization of Better Collective’s DMP and contextual targeting solutions. Act as the primary point of contact with our DMP vendor and the internal go-to expert for audience data capabilities. Build, analyze, and scale audience segments using first-party, contextual, and partner data. Profile and segment advertising inventory to ensure scale, brand suitability, and commercial viability. Collaborate with data providers and aggregators to strengthen and expand our data offering. Work closely with Sales, RevOps, Media Planning, and Account Management teams to support data-driven media sales. Help translate data and platform capabilities into clear commercial insights for internal stakeholders. Support FanReach product development by providing actionable insights and operational feedback. Ensure data practices align with privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.). The Ideal Profile: Is This You? 5+ years of experience in Data Operations / RevOps , specifically within a Publisher, Media House, or AdTech Sell-Side environment (Manager / Senior level). Mandatory, hands-on experience operating a DMP (Data Management Platform) —including audience segmentation, taxonomy creation, and activation to power ad inventory and sales. Strong balance of technical data proficiency and commercial revenue strategy —able to translate complex data infrastructure into actionable, monetization-driven insights for Sales and RevOps teams. Proven understanding of first-party data, identity resolution, contextual targeting, and brand suitability frameworks across digital ad channels. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data engineers and commercial stakeholders. Comfortable working independently in an individual contributor (IC) role, owning end-to-end outcomes in fast-paced environments. Nice-to-haves Experience in sports media, iGaming, or performance advertising. Global or multi-market experience (US, LATAM, EMEA). Familiarity with programmatic, direct sales, and data licensing models. Experience working with Google Ad Manager (GAM), with a solid understanding of analytics and the ability to apply data insights (e.g., Google Analytics, campaign and performance metrics) to inform strategy and decision-making. Meet Your Manager & Team You’ll report to Alex Payne , a strategic leader focused on building scalable, data-driven commercial products. Alex values ownership, clarity, and collaboration, and will partner closely with you while giving you the autonomy to build and execute. You’ll also collaborate with Commercial leadership, Product, Tech, and Data teams across regions. Your Growth & Our Culture Collaborative environment with open communication and trust. Global exposure , working with teams across regions and markets. Real ownership & impact : your work directly shapes how the brand shows up every day. Room to grow , with support for learning and new challenges. Balance & flexibility , whenever possible. A culture that’s informal, supportive, and fun, expect memes, good coffee, and lively Slack channels. Ready to Join? We’re excited to learn more about you! Our Interview Process: Application review by our People team Intro interview with Talent / People Interview with the Hiring Manager Final conversation Offer & reference checks Our process may vary slightly by role or location, but we’ll keep you informed at every step.

items.title: Government Affairs Lead - Middle East (UAE or Saudi Arabia based)
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE We are building a Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team with the ambition and expertise to help shape one of the world's most dynamic environments for artificial intelligence and digital innovation. As our Government Affairs Lead for the Middle East, you will help establish and strengthen Cohere's presence across the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the other Gulf Coast countries ensuring the company's voice contributes to the development of AI policy, digital transformation, public-sector innovation, procurement, and economic diversification initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced government affairs professional who thrives at the intersection of government, technology, and public policy, and who wants to help position Cohere as a trusted partner supporting the region's ambitions to become a global leader in artificial intelligence. You will work alongside experienced policy leaders, collaborate closely with senior executives, and contribute directly to Cohere's strategic growth across two of the world's fastest-growing AI markets. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Report directly to Cohere's Head of EMEA Government Affairs & Public Policy, partnering closely with senior leadership, legal, public policy, responsible AI, communications, and commercial teams to develop and execute Cohere's government affairs and stakeholder engagement strategy across the UAE and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. - Serve as Cohere's primary government affairs representative across the region, building trusted relationships with ministries, regulators, government authorities, public-sector organizations, sovereign entities, and innovation agencies. - Monitor and assess legislative, regulatory, and public policy developments affecting artificial intelligence, cloud computing, data governance, cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, and emerging technologies across the region. - Support policy advocacy by developing consultation responses, policy submissions, briefing materials, executive talking points, and stakeholder engagement strategies related to AI regulation, digital economy initiatives, technology policy, and public procurement. - Partner closely with commercial and public sector sales teams to support business development opportunities across government, financial services, telecommunications, energy, and other regulated industries. - Collaborate with communications, marketing, and public relations teams to ensure consistent and effective messaging regarding Cohere's approach to responsible AI, innovation, and technology policy. - Represent Cohere in industry associations, public-private partnerships, conferences, and policy forums across the Middle East. - Develop and manage relationships with external government affairs consultants, advisors, and trade associations across the region. - Ensure all government engagement, lobbying, and political activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable local laws, regulations, and company policies. - Contribute to broader regional government affairs initiatives across the GCC and support cross-functional projects involving international stakeholders. QUALIFICATIONS - 7+ years of experience in government, a ministerial office, public policy, diplomacy, public-sector consulting, regulatory affairs, corporate government affairs, or a leading industry association. - Strong understanding of the policymaking, regulatory, and public-sector landscape in either the United Arab Emirates or the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with the ability to quickly develop expertise across both markets. - Experience building trusted relationships with senior government officials and public-sector stakeholders. - Familiarity with AI policy, digital transformation, innovation policy, cloud technologies, public procurement, or technology regulation. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Professional proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable. - Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex policy developments into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. - A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across international, cross-functional teams spanning multiple time zones. - An entrepreneurial, self-starter mentality with excellent stakeholder management and project execution skills. - Passion for artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and the opportunity to help shape the policy environment supporting responsible AI adoption. - An undergraduate degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, business, economics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Professional proficiency in Arabic. - Existing relationships with government stakeholders in both the UAE and Saudi Arabia. - Experience engaging with GCC institutions or regional organizations. - Experience in enterprise software, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, or another emerging technology sector. - Experience supporting government procurement, digital transformation, or national AI initiatives. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Product Manager, Identity (Mid)
items.description: About MoonPay MoonPay is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition: Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. About the Opportunity In this role, you will own the roadmap for the systems that establish and verify who a MoonPay customer is, from sign-in through KYC clearance. This spans authentication (sign-in, MFA, session security), identity verification (KYC tiers, risk scoring, sanctions screening), and document verification, the vendor-driven flows that sit inside the KYC funnel. You will sit within the Identity team and work closely with Compliance, Risk/Fraud, Legal, and Engineering, as well as the third-party identity verification vendors MoonPay relies on. Your work will directly impact onboarding conversion, fraud loss, and MoonPay's ability to operate compliantly across multiple countries, balancing customer experience against risk and regulatory requirements on every decision. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to own a product area where user experience, fraud risk, and hard regulatory constraints all collide, and who's motivated by getting that balance right rather than optimizing for just one of the three. Drive improvements to onboarding funnels, reducing drop-off in document capture and verification while maintaining or improving fraud and conversion rates. Manage and evaluate third-party KYC/IDV vendor relationships, including performance, cost, and regional coverage. Partner with Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into product specs and rollout plans. Work with Engineering to ship changes to authentication flows without introducing account-takeover or fraud exposure. Define and track funnel metrics. Represent Identity in cross-functional planning with Risk, Fraud, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders. Working familiarity with KYC/AML concepts and authentication concepts. Experience managing or evaluating third-party identity/KYC vendors. Comfort operating in a regulated, multi-region environment where the same feature behaves differently by jurisdiction. items.title: Data Engineer, Data Foundations
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? We're building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most curious people to help us do it. As a member of our Analytics & Data Insights team, you'll tackle the kind of problems that don't have textbook answers yet, launch products that didn't exist a year ago, and help enterprises understand what foundational AI actually means for their bottom line. As a Data Engineer, you will: - Work directly on new customer experiences built on one of the most advanced AI systems in the world - Collaborate daily with researchers and engineers who are some of the best in the world at what they do - Run implementations end-to-end and see initiatives through to real outcomes - Partner across research, marketing, sales, and finance to help define how Cohere grows, with your recommendations feeding directly into products and strategy You may be a good fit if you have: - 5+ years of experience working on production-grade data processing systems - Strong command of Python and SQL - Experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Beam, Spark, or Flink, alongside large-scale data system design - The ability to transform unstructured data into performant datasets in relational databases and blob storage - Familiarity with modern analytics stack tooling such as BigQuery, Airflow, or dbt - Knowledge of Java or Golang (nice to have) - Experience with Kubernetes (nice to have) - Genuine excitement about AI - you follow the research, have opinions, and enjoy being in the weeds - Comfort operating at the edge of what's known, with a desire to build something genuinely new rather than optimise what already exists FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is building a world-class data organization spanning data science, applied science, data engineering, and business analytics. This role sits within the Growth and Enterprise Readiness Data Science team, with a primary focus on accelerating user adoption, engagement, and sustained product usage. As a Growth Data Scientist, you will be the quantitative partner to Growth Product, Engineering, and Applied AI (Post Sales). You’ll turn ambiguous growth opportunities into measurable product bets, build the measurement and experimentation systems that allow us to learn quickly, and use behavioral data to identify where Glean can create substantially more value for its users. You will: Define and evolve Glean’s growth measurement framework across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, resurrection, and expansion, including metrics such as WAU, activation, engagement intensity, retention, and feature adoption Build and analyze end-to-end user and account growth funnels to understand where users experience value, where they drop off, and which behaviors are most predictive of durable engagement Diagnose adoption gaps and develop bottoms-up growth strategies for high-impact enterprise accounts, identifying where product, deployment, engagement, or organizational barriers are limiting growth and partnering with Applied AI and R&D leaders on targeted interventions. Identify and size high-leverage growth opportunities across onboarding, product discoverability, education, lifecycle messaging, collaboration and virality, and new product surfaces Partner across R&D and Applied AI to turn product capabilities and behavioral insights into scalable adoption plays, identifying the customers and user populations best suited for new experiences and translating those opportunities into targeted field interventions. Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to translate product ideas into testable hypotheses, well-defined success metrics, instrumentation plans, and decision criteria Design and analyze rigorous A/B tests, phased rollouts, and quasi-experiments; use causal evidence to recommend whether products should launch, iterate, or change direction Develop behavioral and needs-based user segments and translate those insights into targeted product interventions Inform roadmap and investment decisions by quantifying reachable populations, expected impact, confidence, dependencies, and tradeoffs before significant development begins Build trusted, reusable growth datasets, dashboards, and self-serve analytical tools that allow Product and Engineering partners to independently understand product health and investigate changes Lead cross-functional data science projects end-to-end, translating ambiguous product questions into clear insights, recommendations, and decisions for audiences ranging from engineers to executives Example areas of focus could include improving new-user onboarding and activation, converting occasional users into habitual users, increasing adoption of emerging AI experiences, optimizing high-traffic entry surfaces, improving feature discovery, developing lifecycle strategies, and building account-level adoption frameworks for enterprise customers, and translating new product capabilities into scalable Applied AI adoption motions. You are: 7+ years of experience in a highly quantitative data science, product analytics, or growth analytics role, with a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to identify opportunities and influence product roadmap decisions Strong grounding in statistics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical power, segmentation, funnel analysis, and retention analysis Exceptionally high AI proficiency through habitual, high-value use of LLMs, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them, rigorous validation, and continuous workflow improvement Experience designing and analyzing product experiments and communicating causal findings in a way that drives clear product decisions Strong proficiency in SQL and practical fluency in a statistical programming language such as Python or R Experience building durable analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and data models rather than relying primarily on ad hoc analysis. dbt experience is a plus. items.title: Network Engineer
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Network Engineering team within IT and Security advances the mission of deploying artificial general intelligence (AGI) for the benefit of all by delivering secure, scalable, and resilient network services. We build and operate the connectivity that supports OpenAI’s offices, labs, campuses, cloud environments, people, and devices. By combining strong network fundamentals with security, reliability, automation, and user-centered design, we enable impactful AI research, corporate operations, and product innovation. About the Role As a Network Engineer at OpenAI, you will design, operate, and continuously improve the global networks that connect our offices, labs, campuses, PoPs, cloud environments, people, and devices. The role spans strategic platform engineering and responsive production operations: you will shape architecture, standards, roadmaps, lifecycle plans, and automation while supporting incidents, escalations, and time-sensitive delivery. Operational signals will inform what we stabilize, simplify, standardize, or automate next. We work backward from user needs, investigate root causes, own outcomes end-to-end, and move quickly without compromising security. We are looking for a versatile engineer who can make pragmatic reliability and security tradeoffs, communicate clearly, and turn recurring operational work into durable platforms, tooling, and standards. You will partner across IT, Security, AppEng, Research, Applied, workplace teams, carriers, and vendors. In this role, you will: - Design, implement, and operate secure, scalable enterprise networks across offices, labs, campuses, PoPs, cloud connectivity, and hybrid environments. - Set strategic direction for network services through architecture, standards, roadmaps, lifecycle planning, capacity strategy, and measurable reliability outcomes. - Own production operations, including on-call, incident response, escalations, and time-sensitive delivery, while protecting user experience, security, and business continuity. - Use incident learning, problem management, ticket trends, and telemetry as roadmap inputs, eliminating recurring failure modes through automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and safer operating standards. - Develop dashboards, telemetry, alerts, and health checks that provide actionable visibility into network performance and failure domains. - Implement and operate routing, switching, wireless, WAN, Internet edge, firewall, NAC, segmentation, and core network services. - Lead network changes, migrations, refreshes, site launches, and service improvements from design through validation and operational handoff. - Partner with security and identity teams to apply least privilege, Zero Trust principles, RBAC, device identity, and appropriate access controls. - Balance long-term platform improvements with urgent operational priorities through clear ownership, documented decisions, deliberate tradeoffs, and transparent communication. You may be a fit for this role if you have: - Hands-on experience designing and operating enterprise networks using platforms such as Cisco IOS, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, Arista, or equivalent technologies. - Strong routing and switching fundamentals, including BGP, OSPF, VLAN/VRF design, WAN, Internet edge, and high-availability patterns. - Production troubleshooting experience across packets, logs, telemetry, configurations, circuits, and physical infrastructure. - Experience with network observability using tools and protocols such as SNMP, syslog, NetFlow, packet capture, ELK, Grafana, or comparable platforms. - Strong network security fundamentals, including ACLs, firewalls, VPN, 802.1X/NAC, device profiling, segmentation, and least privilege. - Ability to automate infrastructure using a modern programming language and tools such as Python, Go, Terraform, Ansible, APIs, Git, and CI/CD. - Experience with enterprise wireless and at least one cloud or hybrid connectivity environment. - Clear communication, sound operational judgment, and the ability to own outcomes while partnering across technical and business teams You might thrive in this role if you have: - Experience shaping a multi-quarter network roadmap while supporting production operations and changing delivery needs. - Experience with optical transport and carrier services, including DWDM, wavelengths, dark fiber, DIA, or similar technologies. - Experience with cloud and virtual WAN architectures such as Azure Virtual WAN, AWS Transit Gateway, or comparable services. - Experience with campus, data center, colocation, or PoP architecture, interconnects, high-availability design, and operational handoff. - Experience building internal platforms, self-service workflows, or AI-assisted automation that measurably reduces operational toil. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is seeking an experienced Customer Programs Manager to build the operational foundation that allows our customer marketing engine to scale. As our advocacy and co-marketing programs grow across startups, digital-native businesses, and enterprise accounts, we need someone who can turn our scaled co-marketing program into a well-instrumented, repeatable and measurable system. You'll deploy resources and capital to create compelling customer stories across formats, and amplify them across both bespoke partnerships and agency-run campaigns. You’ll also own the broader customer marketing intake process and its tooling, and the system of record for how customers participate across advocacy and co-marketing. You'll work closely with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, and Brand, reconciling co-marketing spend each quarter, briefing agencies on which stories we want to tell, and partnering with Marketing Ops and Data Science to build the measurement framework we use to report back to leadership on impact. You'll help shape how a rapidly growing function operates, at a moment when customer proof is one of the most powerful levers we have for building trust in beneficial AI. Key responsibilities: Own the investment behind our customer co-marketing programs, covering allocation tracking, spend pacing, agency coordination, and quarterly budget reconciliation across a rotating cohort of customer accounts Develop and execute co-marketing plans with participating customers that grow Claude adoption and the customer's own reach, coordinating with Growth Marketing on campaign strategy. Run the always-on scaled co-marketing motion, co-producing high-quality creative assets with a rotating cohort of customers and deploying agency partners to amplify them as paid campaigns on the customer's own channels Partner with Customer Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships to decide which customers we work with and build the criteria that keep those decisions consistent Own the customer marketing intake process and its tooling, keeping it the system of record and building the playbooks that keep it consistent as we scale, partnering with Customer Marketing segment leads who own triage and prioritization for their segments Define how we measure the impact of our customer marketing investments, working with Marketing Ops and Data Science, and use that measurement to shape investment decisions with leadership Report back to participating customers on what their participation returned, measured on the outcomes they care about, like reach, engagement, and new customer acquisition Use Claude as a core part of your operational toolkit — building skills, automating intake and triage, and finding leverage wherever a process can be made faster or smarter for the Customer Marketing team Minimum qualifications Managed co-marketing growth or partner investment programs and are comfortable with the reconciliation, forecasting, agency coordination, and stakeholder reporting that comes with it Managed agencies as a working partner, developing the brief, directing the work, and holding the quality bar on co-branded creative Built joint marketing plans with partners or customers that served their goals as much as your own Working knowledge of demand generation and paid social and the ability to optimize campaigns Experience defining how a program gets measured and proving its impact, both to your own leadership and back to the customer in the terms they care about Existing fluency with Claude, and the instinct to reach for it to automate, analyze, and scale your own work Comfort building in a fast-moving environment where the program, the budget, and the priorities are all still taking shape Preferred qualifications 7+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, including at least 3 years in customer marketing. Partner marketing or program management experience is a strong plus. Experience operating co-marketing or partner marketing programs at a developer-focused or AI/ML company Background in revenue operations or marketing analytics, and hands-on comfort in Salesforce and BI tooling Experience proving incremental program impact against a comparison group rather than reporting activity Experience standing up or owning the tooling behind a marketing program — intake forms, workflow automation, dashboards, or a customer participation database Comfort working closely with Sales teams and an understanding of how customer marketing supports pipeline and retention The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Partner Marketing Manager, Launches
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners. When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end. Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches — the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side. You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work. This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners — briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together. You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners. The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you. Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it. Key responsibilities Own partner launch readiness end-to-end, serving as the directly responsible individual for every model, feature, and solution launch across the partner ecosystem — from the first briefing through launch-day go-live and reach reporting Define the operating model for partner launches: set the standard for what readiness means, decide what's durable enough to share and when, and own the trade-offs when timelines and partner needs conflict Equip partner sellers and solution architects to position Claude for a customer workload without escalating to us — segment-specific enablement, technical content, and the materials their field actually reaches for Translate Anthropic positioning for partner surfaces, taking source messaging from Product Marketing and creating partner-specific versions that account for what's available where, what each partner needs to hear, and how the narrative lands on their platform Own the go-to-market motion for joint and co-built solutions on partner surfaces — position what a partner and Anthropic have built together, make the value legible to that partner's sellers and customers, and land it across the channels where their buyers look Work with Partnerships, Product, and partner-side teams to shape solutions into launchable moments, and make the call on which are worth a launch at all Run launch execution – Manage cross-functional review cycles, support partner launch preparedness, compile post-launch reporting Build post-launch momentum through partner webinars, technical content pipelines, and campaigns that keep partners selling after launch-day Represent the partner perspective internally — surface Anthropic-direct launches that will affect partner relationships, flag partner-experience issues in product decisions, and make sure partner considerations arrive early rather than as a fire drill Turn informal knowledge into documented, repeatable process as our release cadence and partner portfolio grow, and build the function so it scales beyond any one person Minimum qualifications Have done partner marketing or product marketing work for or on cloud AI/ML platforms — positioning products on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or directly comparable surfaces, whether from inside a cloud provider or as an independent software vendor launching on one Understand how cloud partner organizations actually work — how their sellers are compensated, what makes a partner's field choose to lead with one vendor over another, and how co-sell and marketplace mechanics shape that choice Have written and rewritten positioning yourself, not only coordinated it; can tell what makes messaging land with a technical audience, and can spot the claim that Legal will flag before Legal does Have set direction on programs rather than only executing them — defining how the work gets done and bringing others along, not inheriting a playbook Can drive cross-functional work without direct authority, pushing internal teams and external partner organizations toward deadlines while keeping the relationships intact, in fast-moving environments where dates move and information is incomplete Handle confidential information rigorously, including tiered need-to-know structures and pre-announcement codenames Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial Preferred qualifications A partner enablement background — you have designed and delivered enablement for a partner's sellers or solution architects, not only produced materials for them Have worked directly at AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft, in partner marketing on AI/ML services Have taken joint or co-built solutions to market with a partner — reference architectures, industry solutions, marketplace offerings, or similar Can position both a product and a solution — the launch of a new capability and the story of what customers build with it — and know that the two are different jobs Have built a launch function or launch process from scratch, not only run an existing one Background in competitive intelligence or competitive messaging Experience marketing to developers or other technical audiences Familiarity with cloud marketplace listings and the enterprise procurement motion Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Talent Program Manager on the Talent Programs team within People Success, you'll own the design and execution of how Coinbase selects and evaluates talent at scale. This team defines the strategy, systems, and processes that keep our hiring engine running with the highest quality, and this role sits at the center of that work. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role AI has the power to dramatically accelerate the pace of scientific discovery and the development of healthcare interventions. We're hiring Anthropic’s first dedicated Life Sciences Counsel to work side-by-side with our researchers as they work to advance biomedical progress. items.title: Senior Web Engineer, Perpetuals
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is launching perpetual futures and we're looking for a Senior Web Engineer to own the frontend of our perps product. You'll build the trading interfaces that traders will rely on every day: order entry, position management, real-time market data, and the full suite of UI that makes a great perps exchange feel fast, reliable, and intuitive. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of frontend product development, backend systems, performance, and reliability. We want someone who has shipped trading UIs before, understands the domain deeply, and can move fast without compromising quality. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and ship complex trading UI features end-to-end — order books, position panels, trade history, funding rates, liquidation displays, and more — making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability - Work closely with backend engineers to design APIs, reason through real-time data flows, and build reliable trading experiences on top of complex exchange systems - Partner with QA, TPM, product, and design to clarify requirements, manage launches, and improve product quality - Monitor dashboards, alerts, and user reports to identify and respond to issues quickly; work with backend and infrastructure teams during incidents to isolate root causes and follow through with fixes - Design and implement UI that handles live market data, streaming order books, and fast-moving prices in a way that feels responsive and accurate to traders - Build and improve the logs, metrics, alerts, dashboards, and error reporting that give the team visibility into frontend system performance - Identify meaningful technical debt, propose pragmatic refactors, and contribute to system design discussions that evolve our frontend architecture as the product scales WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3–5+ years of frontend web engineering experience - Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend development - Experience building trading, exchange, or financial product UIs — you understand the domain and know what a great trading interface requires - Strong frontend system design instincts across state management, data fetching, caching, performance, reliability, and maintainability - Experience working with real-time data: WebSockets, streaming APIs, or live market feeds - Strong debugging skills and experience responding to production issues - Comfortable working with backend engineers on APIs, data contracts, failure modes, and system behavior - High agency — you notice problems, propose solutions, and drive work to completion - Clear communicator during planning, launches, bugs, and incidents - (Plus) Direct experience building UI for a perpetuals exchange or derivatives trading product - (Plus) Frontend performance specialization, particularly around real-time data rendering - (Plus) Experience in crypto, Web3, or adjacent financial infrastructure - (Plus) Experience improving frontend observability, alerting, or reliability practices - (Plus) Strong practical use of AI tools to improve engineering productivity BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: Senior Campaign Manager
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket's marketing team is building the creator and UGC engine that introduces millions of people to prediction markets for the first time. This is a Senior Campaign Manager role sitting within that team, reporting to a director, and owning the full lifecycle of influencer and UGC campaigns from initial brief through final performance report. You will work across creative, product, and leadership to get campaigns out the door and make them better each time. The challenge here is real. Polymarket is a crypto-native, news-driven product that lives and dies by current events. The content that works today may not work next week. You need to move fast, have genuine taste, and know how to brief a creator so they produce something that actually converts, not just something that looks good in a recap deck. This is not a role for someone who needs a lot of direction or who treats campaign analysis as a formality. This is a backfill, so the infrastructure exists. What we need is someone who can step in, take ownership immediately, and raise the bar on both execution quality and the rigor with which we learn from results. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own active influencer and UGC campaigns end-to-end, from writing the brief to delivering the final performance report with clear takeaways. - Source and manage creator partnerships across relevant verticals, building relationships that produce repeat, high-quality content rather than one-off posts. - Brief creators clearly and manage feedback rounds with the internal creative team, keeping timelines tight and quality high. - Pull campaign performance data regularly, identify what is working and what is not, and translate those findings into concrete changes for the next campaign. - Manage up to directors by proactively communicating campaign status, flagging blockers early, and coming to meetings with answers rather than questions. - Navigate cross-functional workflows across product, creative, and leadership without needing hand-holding, keeping campaigns moving even when internal processes are ambiguous. - Stay current on content formats, creator trends, and platform shifts so that Polymarket's campaigns reflect what is actually resonating right now, not what worked six months ago. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4 to 5 years of experience running influencer and UGC campaigns for tech companies, with work that spans both brand awareness and conversion-focused content. - Demonstrated ability to analyze campaign performance data and implement specific, measurable changes to subsequent campaigns based on what you found. - Experience managing creator relationships independently, including sourcing, briefing, and holding partners accountable to deliverables and quality standards. - Comfort working cross-functionally and managing up, including regular communication with directors and navigating internal workflows that are not always clearly defined. - Genuine fluency in online culture and content, you consume it, you understand what is landing right now, and you can apply that instinct to a product tied to real-world events. - Strong written communication skills, particularly when it comes to creative briefs and performance summaries that drive decisions rather than just document activity. - (Plus) Prior experience working on crypto, web3, or fintech products, or comfort marketing a product that requires some audience education. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $125,000 to $150,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is building the Applied AI team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it. As the first FDE Manager, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow. Responsibilities Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts. Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers. Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities. Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work. Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems. Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed. Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field. Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned. Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning. Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts. You may be a good fit if you have 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting. 2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers. Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one. Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics. Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers. Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences. Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist. Why this role matters You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £255,000 — £325,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

You'll be designing the models, frameworks, and systems that protect the exchange as we launch perpetuals and traditional commodity derivatives into a live, fast-moving market. The US Exchange team is small and moving quickly. You'll work directly with engineers, product leads, and compliance to translate quantitative risk thinking into real infrastructure. items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role Overview: At Cohere, we're pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can achieve for production environments, and we're seeking a senior engineer who understands the practical challenges of making AI systems work at scale. This role demands deep technical expertise in production environments and the ability to bridge research concepts with real-world implementations. This position is hands-on and engineering-driven. You'll focus on production systems, experiment with frontier models, and collaborate with talented engineers to build scalable, production ready solutions. We strive for excellence in both engineering and science by meticulously designing experiments and design docs. We blend engineering and research seamlessly. Everyone contributes to both, depending on organizational needs. We provide access to world class compute resources, data, and talent to ensure you can do your best work. This role is perfect for you if you: - Have a deep passion for quality work. - Enjoy tuning and optimising large LLM models. - Comfortable working with people with different levels of software engineering skills, from beginner to more advanced. - Comfortable diving into complex ML codebases to identify and resolve issues, ensuring the smooth operation of our systems. - Thrive in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment, where you can contribute your innovative ideas and solutions. Key responsibilities: - Design and write high-performing and scalable software for training models. - Develop new tools to support and accelerate research and LLM training. - Coordinate with other engineering teams (Infrastructure, Efficiency, Serving) and the scientific teams (Agent, Multimodal, Multilingual, etc.). - Research, implement, and experiment with ideas on our cluster and data infrastructure. - Collaborate, Collaborate, and Collaborate with other scientists, engineers, and teams! Qualifications: - Extremely strong software engineering skills. - Value test-driven development methods, clean code, and strive to reduce technical debts at all levels. - Proficiency in Python and related ML frameworks such as JAX, Pytorch and/or XLA/MLIR. - Experience using and debugging large-scale distributed training strategies (memory/speed profiling). - Experience with distributed training infrastructures (Kubernetes) and associated frameworks (Ray). - Experience in ML and LLM academic research. Working Location: This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. items.title: PCBA Manufacturing Engineer
items.description: About the Team OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization is building the world's most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. We work closely with hardware design teams, manufacturing partners, suppliers, and data center operations to deliver the compute platforms that power frontier AI. The Manufacturing Engineering team ensures our hardware can be built, tested, deployed, and supported at hyperscale. We bridge Hardware Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Contract Manufacturers, and Hardware Operations to continuously improve manufacturing performance throughout the product lifecycle. As our fleet grows globally, sustaining manufacturing engineering becomes increasingly important to maintain product quality, improve manufacturability, and rapidly resolve production issues. About the Role We are seeking a PCBA Manufacturing Engineer (Sustaining) to support production and continuous improvement of printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) used throughout Industrial Compute hardware platforms. This role focuses on sustaining engineering after product launch. You'll partner closely with Hardware Design, Quality, Manufacturing, Test Engineering, Supply Chain, and our contract manufacturers to resolve production issues, improve manufacturing yield, reduce failures, implement engineering changes, and ensure stable high-volume manufacturing. The ideal candidate has experience supporting complex server, networking, accelerator, storage, or high-performance electronics manufacturing environments. Key Responsibilities - Own sustaining manufacturing engineering for PCBA production across multiple hardware platforms. - Drive root cause investigations for manufacturing defects, field failures, and production escapes. - Partner with Hardware Design Engineers to improve manufacturability (DFM/DFA/DFT). - Support engineering change orders (ECOs) and manufacturing change implementation. - Work directly with contract manufacturers to improve production yield, cycle time, and quality. - Analyze manufacturing data to identify recurring process issues and improvement opportunities. - Develop corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for manufacturing and supplier quality issues. - Support failure analysis activities including electrical, functional, and process investigations. - Improve manufacturing documentation, work instructions, assembly processes, and test procedures. - Collaborate with Test Engineering to improve production test coverage and manufacturing diagnostics. - Support supplier qualification, process validation, and manufacturing readiness for design revisions. - Travel to manufacturing partners as needed to support production and issue resolution. Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field. - 5+ years supporting high-volume PCBA manufacturing. - Experience with SMT manufacturing, PCB fabrication, and electronic assembly processes. - Strong understanding of manufacturing process control, yield improvement, and statistical analysis. - Experience performing root cause analysis using methodologies such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, or FMEA. - Experience working with contract manufacturers and global supply chains. - Ability to interpret schematics, BOMs, assembly drawings, and manufacturing documentation. - Excellent cross-functional communication and project management skills. Preferred Skills - Experience with server, accelerator, networking, storage, or AI hardware platforms. - Familiarity with ICT, Flying Probe, Boundary Scan, Functional Test, and System-Level Test. - Experience supporting high-speed PCBAs involving GPUs, CPUs, memory, PCIe, Ethernet, or high-speed interconnects. - Knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-A-610, IPC-6012, IPC-7711/7721). - Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), PLM systems, and engineering change management. - Enjoy solving complex manufacturing problems using data and structured root cause analysis. - Like working directly with manufacturing partners and factory teams. - Can bridge hardware design and manufacturing execution. - Have strong troubleshooting skills across electronics, assembly processes, and production testing. - Enjoy continuous improvement and process optimization. - Are comfortable balancing technical depth with fast operational execution.
